evals.prompt: Create a new skill for Defender incident triage.
evals.expected_output: Checks for overlapping skills, proposes a valid lowercase hyphenated skill name, creates a concise SKILL.md plan, and includes evals/evals.json test cases.
assertions: The output requires or creates evals/evals.json
The output uses a valid Agent Skills name
The output checks for existing overlapping skills
The output keeps source-backed references outside the main skill body when detailed

evals.expected_output: Flags the name as invalid and suggests microsoft-portal-navigation or another valid lowercase hyphenated equivalent.
assertions: The output says the supplied name is invalid
The output mentions lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
The output provides a valid replacement name
